title: cereus arboreus
intro: Cereus arboreus, commonly known as the chain fruit cholla or pencil cholla, is a species of cactus in the genus Cereus, native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is known for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and providing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cereus arboreus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, making it useful in treating various skin conditions and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Cereus arboreus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
